oneOf.description: A run reached a terminal state (produced a record, or failed before one).

NotificationOutcome.description:
Whether a finished run produced a record. `completed` carries a record id to
open; `failed` carries a reason.

oneOf.description: The run produced a record (its own `status.state` may still be a failure).
The run could not be driven to a record at all.

description:
A worker-wide notification that a run reached a terminal state. Carries the
run's display identity (flattened to the console's notification shape) plus
how it ended. Delivered over `GET /notifications` (SSE).

harnessSlug.description: The harness driving the run, as its slug string.

jobId.description: The job id the run was observed under.

kind.description: The notification kind. Only `run-completed` exists today.

message.description: A human-readable failure reason, present when `outcome` is `failed`.

modelId.description: The opaque model id passed to the harness.

recordId.description:
The persisted run record's id the console links the alert to: the produced
record's id for a `completed` run, the job id for a `failed` one.

title: Notification
